name: Presenter Studio
description: Talking-to-camera videos with lip-synced speech: YouTube explainers, UGC ads, testimonials and spokesperson videos. Writes the script, uses the user's photo of the presenter or casts a fictional one with Nano Banana Pro, speaks the script (or uses the user's own recording) and lip-syncs the presenter to it. The voice (Kokoro) runs free on the local machine; the presenter is filmed with Kling and lip-synced with Kling LipSync (Sync Lipsync 1.9 as fallback) on fal.

execution.service_target: engines/presenter_engine.py (local Kokoro voice; Kling base clip + Kling LipSync / Sync Lipsync 1.9 on fal)

source.license: Kokoro: Apache-2.0; Kling and Sync: fal commercial API

best_for: YouTube-style explainer videos with a person talking to camera
UGC ads: a creator holding the product and talking to a phone camera
lip-syncing a photo of a person to the user's own voice recording
not_good_for: films with several locations or scenes (one presenter, one framing; long speech is joined with jump cuts)
lip-syncing an existing video of a person
several people talking to each other
profile_notes: Added 2026-11-13. Free by default: voice Kokoro (Apache-2.0, local CPU; English, Hindi, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, Chinese) installed with tools/local_lipsync/setup.sh. Presenter photo: the user's, else Nano Banana Pro on fal (paid, cents). 2026-11-17: lip-sync is paid on fal - one 10 s Kling image-to-video base clip of the presenter, then each speech part (2-10 s, cut at pauses) is lip-synced onto its own window of it with Kling LipSync (fal-ai/kling-video/lipsync/audio-to-video), falling back to Sync Lipsync 1.9 (fal-ai/sync-lipsync); the local Ditto lip-sync was removed. PRESENTER_PAID=on only adds ElevenLabs as a voice fallback. Parts are joined with jump cuts. Test quality: up to 15 s; full: up to 180 s. No captions yet.
